_figmaFile_note: Which Figma file to sync. Accepts a full figma.com/design/<key>/... link OR a bare file key. Override per-run with the FIGMA_FILE env var. Controls the REST pull target; the plugin-dump pull and push run against whichever file the Figma plugin is connected to (the generated push script names the intended file as a guard-rail).
_primitiveCollections_note: Mode-independent Figma collections, as `tokens.json section` -> `Figma collection name`. Each becomes its own section in tokens.json and its own labelled block inside the single :root of theme.css, so a token's origin collection survives the round trip — that is what lets tokens:push file a NEWLY created token back into the collection it came from instead of dumping everything into Foundation. Order matters only for the emitted CSS order. The legacy singular `primitiveCollection` is still honoured and means `{ "primitives": <value> }`.
_note: Figma structure: Foundation = shared primitives (mode 'Mode 1'); Semantic = tokens with the THEME as the mode axis (currently one mode: 'AceTrader'). `default` is stock shadcn (hand-maintained src/themes/default.css) and is intentionally NOT synced. Add a key under `themes` per Figma Semantic mode you want to sync.
_pipeline_note: 2-way token sync. Source of truth = tokens.json (designer-owned DATA). This file holds engineer-owned PROJECTION rules (slotMap, selectors, collections). Legs: tokens:pull (Figma dump -> tokens.json), tokens:build (tokens.json -> CSS), tokens:push (tokens.json -> Figma plugin script). `default` theme is code-only (src/themes/default.css) and outside this pipeline.
_slotMap_note: Near-identity. The Figma Semantic collection now models the shadcn contract directly (Base/*, Status/*, Chart/*, Sidebar/*), so a token's normalized name IS its slot name and build-css emits it from the raw section — build-css skips any slot where ref === slot. Only --radius still needs a mapping, because it aliases a Foundation primitive rather than a semantic token. Do not re-add identity entries; they emit nothing. NOTE: an unmapped slot does NOT fall back to nothing; index.css imports default.css first, so .theme-grade10 inherits default's LIGHT-mode value for anything it does not define.
